messages:
Samir: Quick sync 52 cloud marketplace onboarding with NimbusCore + AtlasHW next Wed. We need a partner SEV path defined before GA: shared channel, warroom triggers, and a dry-run. Initial proposal below. Feedback?

Tia: Partner asked for a shared channel. Legal flagged data bleed concerns. We should list allowed message types in the channel (status updates, escalation headers) and put sensitive troubleshooting in the private bridge.

Maria: Agreed. I'll draft the 'shared channel policy' bullet list and a one-line partner-facing header template. Also: add postmortem ownership rules to the runbook.

Chris: Runtime knobs we want on-hand: route->quantized variant, temporary token cap, and autoscale-to-dedicated. I'll add quick CLI snippets to the playbook.

Devon: Proposed escalation matrix: P0 = immediate PagerDuty page + OpsBot normalized alert + auto-bridge; P1 = shared-channel ping + 30min SLA for SRE ack; P2 = async via shared channel and tag partner liaison. Keep roles explicit.

Samir: Draft roles: Partner liaison=Tia, CS lead=Maria, Eng on-call=Chris, SRE on-call=Alex-SRE, Runbook owner=Devon. Confirm?

Alex-SRE: I confirm SRE on-call. I'll own bridge creation and log export steps. We'll standardize the bridge URL format and recording.

Tia: I'll own partner comms. Draft channel topic we should use: "P0 -> PagerDuty page -> bridge up. P1 -> shared update. See pinned runbook."

Maria: I'll pin the runbook and the contact matrix to the channel when it's created. Runbook link (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-nimbus-core

Chris: CLI snippets for runbook (to keep in pinned snippet):

```bash
# fallback to quantized model variant
redwoodctl route set --customer nimbus --model nimbus-small-quant --priority emergency
# temporarily clamp tokens to reduce latency
redwoodctl config set --customer nimbus --request_max_tokens 200
# promote to dedicated pool if queueing > 5s
redwoodctl capacity promote --customer nimbus --pool dedicated-reserve
```

Devon: OpsBot payload we want for normalized alerts (example in runbook):

```text
ALERT_ID: {{id}}
SEVERITY: P0
SUMMARY: High inference latency > 500ms (5m avg)
ACTIONS: page:oncall, create:bridge, notify:partner-liaison
RUNBOOK: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-nimbus-core#playbook
```

OpsBot: DRY-RUN -> simulated P0 fired (latency test). Posting normalized alert to #shared-nimbus-redwood and triggering PagerDuty. alert_id=nimbus-dry-20260321-01 :rotating_light:

Alex-SRE: Acknowledged the dry-run page. Standing up bridge now; will post link in 30s. :thumbsup:

Tia: Will send a quick partner note once bridge is available and mark it DRY-RUN. Also will provide partners the brief policy (what to post in channel).

Samir: Thanks. Proposed dry-run time: Tue 10:00 PT. Everyone reply with :thumbsup: or propose alt.

Maria: :thumbsup: works for CS. I'll verify partner availability.

Chris: :thumbsup: can confirm eng on-call.

Devon: :thumbsup: I'll run the OpsBot simulated alerts and verify the PagerDuty handoff.

Alex-SRE: :thumbsup: will test bridge recording + log export.

Tia: :thumbsup: will coordinate partner invite.

Samir: I'll update the runbook with the decisions and tag owners. Action items for this thread: Samir -> update runbook and create calendar invite; Maria -> pin runbook & contact list; Alex-SRE -> add bridge checklist snippet; Chris -> add CLI fallback commands; Devon -> add OpsBot payload examples; Tia -> draft partner policy and channel topic.

OpsBot: NOTE: dry-run complete (simulated). PagerDuty flow validated. Logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/dry/nimbus-dry-20260321-01 :white_check_mark:

Samir: Closing thread 52 dry-run Tue 10:00 PT. I'll post updated runbook link here once it's live. Appreciate the quick responses. :rocket:
